summary: Unified 3 KuzuRepository implementations into single canonical infrastructure/kuzu.py. Merged hybrid_search, semantic_search (Python-side), compute_blast_radius, get_max_lamport_tick, transparent zstd compression. Fixed EmbeddingProvider import in memory/models.py (broken fallback). Replaced VaultEmbeddingIndex fake SHA-256 vectors with real 384-dim FastEmbed vectors. Enabled graph_write_mode=READY_CANDIDATE (was SIMULATED). Marked kuzu_adapter.py and kuzu_repository.py as deprecated wrappers.

Session reuse by role: plan/build/review with automatic routing. SessionStore now supports find_or_create_session(role, context_id), close_session(), archive_session(), list_sessions_by_role(), list_active_sessions(). DummieSessionManager updated with get_or_create_role_session(). Sessions are reused when role+context match, new sessions created when previous closed.

Group chat coordinator: @planner, @builder, @reviewer, @overseer as explicit agent roles within a single opencode session. Each role has dedicated model, system prompt, and subagents. Message queue for inter-role communication. Pipeline chain activation (planner→builder→reviewer). Integrated into heartbeat orchestrator.

SemanticCache upgraded from exact-match SHA256 to real semantic similarity via EmbeddingProvider (cosine similarity threshold 0.92). Two-tier: local in-memory (exact) + vector-based semantic. LRU eviction at 200 entries. Integrated with Kuzu for cross-session persistence.

Heartbeat upgraded to autonomous conductor (director de orquesta). Integrated group chat coordinator, role-based session routing, worktree isolation, multi-model audit, and full .aiwg traceability. Conductor log at .aiwg/heartbeat/conductor_log.jsonl. Pipeline chain: planner→builder→reviewer auto-activated per action. Signal now includes group chat state and active pipeline.

Canonizacion total: 50+ specs actualizadas (read-only→produccion), 13 schemas actualizados (SIMULATED/DRY_RUN_ONLY removidos), flat_brain eliminado (165 archivos migrados a organos canonicos), 17 imports legacy corregidos a paths canonicos, runtime state limpiado. DUMMIE Engine oficialmente en fase produccion.
